verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents two API token types: a global token valid across all teams, and a team-scoped Uptime API token limited to managing Uptime resources. This gives an agent a credential narrower than full-account access, but the scoping is only by team and product rather than fine-grained permissions. missing for 10: permission-level scopes (e.g. read-only or per-resource), agent- or MCP-specific credential issuance, token expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: An Uptime API token is a team-scoped token for managing your Uptime resources.
A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
